title: Homemade Almond Milk
description: Real almond milk made with whole almonds — far more nutritious than store-bought which has barely any almonds.
steps: Cover almonds with water; refrigerate at least 12 hours to soak.
Blend softened almonds with 1000g fresh water for 1 minute.
Strain through cheesecloth over a bowl; squeeze out all liquid.
Optional: return liquid to blender with Guar Gum; blend 30 seconds for an emulsion.
notes: Guar Gum prevents separation — optional but recommended. Same method works with cashews.
